test(context): enforce content-free compaction failure integration

The full ReAct suite still expected arbitrary provider error text in the safe event payload, contradicting the published privacy fix. Assert the fixed diagnostic and scan the real serialized bus event for synthetic private content while preserving errors.Is on the original return.

Reproduced the stale assertion on the exact remote base. Full ReAct race suite and phase 268 smoke pass on Go 1.26.4 with pinned vendored dependencies. Full repository release gates remain pending.
